## Installation

```npm
npx axiom add app-bar
```

Also copies: [`icon-button`](/atoms/icon-button).

## Usage

```tsx title="Conceptual"
import { AppBar } from '@/components/ui/app-bar';

<AppBar>
  <AppBar.Leading>
    <IconButton icon="chevron-left" accessibilityLabel="Back" onPress={goBack} />
  </AppBar.Leading>
  <AppBar.Title>Inbox</AppBar.Title>
  <AppBar.Actions>
    <IconButton icon="search" accessibilityLabel="Search" onPress={openSearch} />
  </AppBar.Actions>
</AppBar>
```

## Props

### AppBar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The `Leading`, `Title`, `Actions` and optional `Search` slots. |
| `variant` | `'compact' \| 'large'` | `'compact'` | Uses a centered 17pt title or a 34pt title on a second row. Use `large` at the root of a section. |
| `bordered` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a hairline under the bar. Useful when content can scroll behind it. |
| `safeArea` | `boolean` | `true` | Adds the top safe-area inset. Set it to `false` when `Scaffold` already owns that inset. |
| `collapseProgress` | `number` | `0` | Progress from `0` to `1` used to collapse a large title and its search field into the compact bar. |
| `backgroundColor` | `ColorValue` | background token | Overrides the bar background without changing the screen background. |
| `style` | `StyleProp<ViewStyle>` | — | Extra styles for the bar container. |

### AppBar.Leading, AppBar.Actions

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | One leading control, or up to two trailing controls. Icon-only controls need an accessibility label. |
| `style` | `StyleProp<ViewStyle>` | — | Extra styles for the slot container. |

The two side slots keep equal minimum widths. That leaves the compact title visually centered even when one side contains more controls.

### AppBar.Title

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Screen title. Plain text gets the correct compact or large text style automatically. |
| `numberOfLines` | `number` | `1` | Maximum lines before truncation. Keep compact titles on one line. |
| `accessibilityRole` | `'header'` | `'header'` | Announces the title as a heading. |

### AppBar.Search

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` | `true` | Moves the search field into the compact bar as `collapseProgress` reaches `1`. |
| `...SearchBarProps` | — | — | Every [SearchBar](/molecules/search-bar) prop, including `value`, `onChangeText` and `onCancel`. |

## Use cases

### Back navigation with actions

Keep the leading control predictable and put screen-specific actions on the right. Two trailing icons are the practical limit before the title gets cramped.

<PhonePreview size="sm">
  <div class="ax-appbar" data-border><span class="ax-appbar-slot"><span class="ax-icon-btn"><Glyph name="chevron-left" /></span></span><span class="ax-appbar-title">Order #1842</span><span class="ax-appbar-slot" data-side="end"><span class="ax-icon-btn"><Glyph name="share" /></span><span class="ax-icon-btn"><Glyph name="more" /></span></span></div>
  <div class="ax-body"><span class="ax-title2">Ready to ship</span><span class="ax-subhead ax-muted">2 items · $88.90</span><div class="ax-card" data-variant="outlined"><div class="ax-card-content"><span class="ax-headline">Canvas tote</span><span class="ax-subhead ax-muted">Natural · Quantity 2</span></div></div></div>
</PhonePreview>

```tsx
<AppBar bordered>
  <AppBar.Leading><IconButton icon="chevron-left" accessibilityLabel="Back" onPress={goBack} /></AppBar.Leading>
  <AppBar.Title>Order #1842</AppBar.Title>
  <AppBar.Actions>
    <IconButton icon="share" accessibilityLabel="Share order" onPress={share} />
    <IconButton icon="more" accessibilityLabel="More actions" onPress={openMenu} />
  </AppBar.Actions>
</AppBar>
```

### Large title with search

Use a large title for the first screen in a section. The search field sits below it and can collapse once the list starts moving.

<PhonePreview size="sm">
  <div class="ax-appbar"><span class="ax-appbar-slot" /><span class="ax-appbar-slot ax-grow" data-side="end"><span class="ax-icon-btn"><Glyph name="edit" /></span></span></div>
  <div class="ax-large-heading">Messages</div>
  <div class="ax-body" style={{ paddingTop: '0' }}><div class="ax-searchbar"><Glyph name="search" size={18} /><span class="ax-muted">Search</span><span class="ax-fill" /><Glyph name="mic" size={18} /></div></div>
  <div class="ax-list" data-variant="plain"><div class="ax-item"><span class="ax-avatar" data-photo="4" /><div class="ax-item-content"><span class="ax-item-title">Studio</span><span class="ax-item-desc">3 new messages</span></div></div><div class="ax-item"><span class="ax-avatar" data-photo="5" /><div class="ax-item-content"><span class="ax-item-title">Travel plans</span><span class="ax-item-desc">You: Friday works.</span></div></div></div>
</PhonePreview>

```tsx
<AppBar variant="large" collapseProgress={scrollProgress}>
  <AppBar.Title>Messages</AppBar.Title>
  <AppBar.Actions><IconButton icon="edit" accessibilityLabel="New message" /></AppBar.Actions>
  <AppBar.Search value={query} onChangeText={setQuery} placeholder="Search" />
</AppBar>
```

### Selection mode

Replace navigation controls with the selection count and actions. Do not stack a second bar over the normal one.

<PhonePreview size="sm">
  <div class="ax-appbar" data-border><span class="ax-appbar-slot"><span class="ax-btn" data-variant="ghost" data-size="sm">Cancel</span></span><span class="ax-appbar-title">3 selected</span><span class="ax-appbar-slot" data-side="end"><span class="ax-icon-btn"><Glyph name="share" /></span><span class="ax-icon-btn" style={{ color: 'var(--ax-feedback-error)' }}><Glyph name="trash" /></span></span></div>
  <div class="ax-list" data-variant="plain"><div class="ax-item"><span class="ax-checkbox" data-state="checked"><Glyph name="check" size={14} /></span><div class="ax-item-content"><span class="ax-item-title">Quarterly report.pdf</span><span class="ax-item-desc">2.4 MB</span></div></div><div class="ax-item"><span class="ax-checkbox" data-state="checked"><Glyph name="check" size={14} /></span><div class="ax-item-content"><span class="ax-item-title">Research notes.txt</span><span class="ax-item-desc">18 KB</span></div></div><div class="ax-item"><span class="ax-checkbox" /><div class="ax-item-content"><span class="ax-item-title">References.zip</span><span class="ax-item-desc">31 MB</span></div></div></div>
</PhonePreview>

```tsx
<AppBar bordered>
  <AppBar.Leading><Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onPress={clearSelection}>Cancel</Button></AppBar.Leading>
  <AppBar.Title>{selected.length} selected</AppBar.Title>
  <AppBar.Actions>
    <IconButton icon="share" accessibilityLabel="Share selected items" />
    <IconButton icon="trash" accessibilityLabel="Delete selected items" />
  </AppBar.Actions>
</AppBar>
```

## Scroll behavior

Drive `collapseProgress` with the scroll position instead of putting scroll logic inside the bar. See [Behaviors: scroll](/behaviors#scroll).
